subject: Palo Alto customer roadshow — venue deposit and cost allocation
messages:
From: Sage Events (Samantha Lee) <samantha@sageevents.co>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Deposit & invoice for Palo Alto venue (requesting PO)

Hi Ben —

Thanks for confirming the Palo Alto venue for the customer roadshow on Sept 16–17. Attached is the vendor invoice (Sage_Invoice_42.pdf) for the 50% deposit: $12,400. Per our terms we need payment or a PO within 7 business days to hold the date.

A few quick notes:
- Deposit required to lock the main hall and breakout rooms
- Final headcount will confirm food/bev; we can adjust final invoice accordingly
- Attached: venue quote and standard W9 (W9_SageEvents.pdf)

Can you confirm who we should send the invoice/PO to and whether Redwood will require a PO ceiling or a direct wire?

Thanks —
Samantha Lee
Account Lead, Sage Events
Samantha@sageevents.co
Attachment: Sage_Invoice_42.pdf
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sage Events <samantha@sageevents.co>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deposit & invoice for Palo Alto venue (requesting PO)

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for sending. We can do a PO for the deposit. I've looped in Marissa and Laura to confirm internal cost split and approval. Preliminary ask from my side: issue a PO ceiling for $18,500 so we have some buffer for AV and on-site extras, and process the deposit of $12,400 against that PO.

Internal guidance for the PO:
- Cost center split: 60% Marketing (rev marketing initiatives), 40% Field Events (customer programs)
- Requesting an advance/payment of $5,000 upfront; remainder of deposit as part of net-30 after final invoice
- Please send the formal invoice and W9 to the billing contact listed in your attachment; for processing, vendor invoices should go to our AP partner at payments@arcadia-vendor.com (they handle vendor payments on our behalf).

Marissa / Laura — can you confirm the PO ceiling and the cost-center percentages? Also confirm whether legal needs to sign the venue T&Cs or if we can accept Sage's standard contract.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sage Events <samantha@sageevents.co>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deposit & invoice for Palo Alto venue (requesting PO)

Ben / Samantha —

I reviewed the quote and W9. I support the PO ceiling of $18,500 and the proposed split: 60% Marketing (cost center 4001), 40% Field Events (cost center 4203). Please include these two cost centers on the PO and on all vendor invoices.

Couple of asks before I finalize:
- Can Sage send a simple line-item breakdown (venue | catering | AV | staffing) so finance can code correctly? A single lump-sum makes reconciliation tricky.
- I'll need the vendor's mailed remit address and bank details (for Arcadia to set up the payment) — if you prefer, please upload to the Drive link: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3cVenueQuotePA
- Attachments: W9_SageEvents.pdf (received) and Venue_Quote_PaloAlto.pdf (reviewed).

Assuming the line items look normal, I will route to sign-off and ask AP to issue a PO number in the next business day.

Marissa
Marissa Cole
Field Marketing Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sage Events <samantha@sageevents.co>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deposit & invoice for Palo Alto venue (requesting PO)

Ben / Marissa / Samantha —

Approved: PO ceiling $18,500; cost center split 60/40 as Marissa requested.

Two conditions before AP issues the PO:
1) Marissa confirms the line-item breakdown (venue | catering | AV | staffing) in writing
2) Vendor confirms remit details and that the deposit is refundable up to 30 days prior per the venue quote.

Once those two are in place, Marissa please confirm and I'll sign off so Arcadia can issue PO-2026-PA-078 (tentative PO identifier for tracking).

Laura
Laura Bennett
Director, Finance Operations (Redwood Project Approvals)
From: Arcadia Vendor Finance <payments@arcadia-vendor.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sage Events <samantha@sageevents.co>
Date: Thu, 20 Aug 2026 17:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Deposit & invoice for Palo Alto venue (requesting PO)

Ben / Marissa —

Thanks for confirming. We received the invoice and W9 from Sage Events and have scheduled the deposit for 08/27 once we receive the PO. Sage confirmed the line-item breakdown and that the 50% deposit is refundable up to 30 days before event. Remit details and bank info have been uploaded to the Drive link you gave and copy is attached on our side.

We will proceed to generate PO-2026-PA-078 as soon as Laura gives the green light; please reply-all to confirm and we'll send the PO and payment confirmation.

Best,
Arcadia Vendor Finance Team
payments@arcadia-vendor.com
Attachment: confirmation_receipt_stub.txt
